title_sq: SHESIM SEBASHKU 2 GARSONIERE TEK KODRA E DIELLIT!

title_en: SEBASHKU 2 STUDIO APARTMENTS FOR SALE AT KODRA E DIELLE!
description_en: Investment opportunity in Kodra del Diellit - 2 studios for sale with active rent! Property Specifications: -Net area: 35.5 m² each -Total area: 82.2 m² -Veranda: 16 m² -The studios are located on the 0th floor of a new building -Each has a certificate of ownership -Currently leased Interior Organization: Combined living & sleeping area, Functional toilets and Private Veranda For more information or for a visit to the property, do not feel free to contact me!
